verses.text: A Psalm of David. O LORD, hear my prayer. In Your faithfulness, give ear to my plea; in Your righteousness, answer me.

xrefs.text: In Your justice, rescue and deliver me; incline Your ear and save me.
I say to the LORD, “You are my God.” Hear, O LORD, my cry for help.
For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; save me by Your righteousness.

O Lord, in keeping with all Your righteous acts, I pray that Your anger and wrath may turn away from Your city Jerusalem, Your holy mountain; for because of our sins and the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and Your people are a reproach to all around us.
If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

verses.text: Do not bring Your servant into judgment, for no one alive is righteous before You.

xrefs.text: Surely there is no righteous man on earth who does good and never sins.
Therefore no one will be justified in His sight by works of the law. For the law merely brings awareness of sin.
How then can a man be just before God? How can one born of woman be pure?
If You, O LORD, kept track of iniquities, then who, O Lord, could stand?
If we say we have not sinned, we make Him out to be a liar, and His word is not in us.

verses.text: For the enemy has pursued my soul, crushing my life to the ground, making me dwell in darkness like those long since dead.

xrefs.text: He has made me dwell in darkness like those dead for ages.
A Shiggaion of David, which he sang to the LORD concerning the words of Cush, a Benjamite. O LORD my God, I take refuge in You; save me and deliver me from all my pursuers,
then may my enemy pursue me and overtake me; may he trample me to the ground and leave my honor in the dust. Selah
I am counted among those descending to the Pit. I am like a man without strength.
Once again, Abner warned Asahel, “Stop chasing me. Why should I strike you to the ground? How could I show my face to your brother Joab?”

verses.text: My spirit grows faint within me; my heart is dismayed inside me.

xrefs.text: Although my spirit grows faint within me, You know my way. Along the path I travel they have hidden a snare for me.
I remembered You, O God, and I groaned; I mused and my spirit grew faint. Selah
And in His anguish, He prayed more earnestly, and His sweat became like drops of blood falling to the ground.
For my days vanish like smoke, and my bones burn like glowing embers.
Fear and trembling grip me, and horror has overwhelmed me.

verses.text: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all Your works; I consider the work of Your hands.

xrefs.text: So I said, “I am grieved that the right hand of the Most High has changed.”
I considered the days of old, the years long in the past.
He has caused His wonders to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.
My people, remember what Balak king of Moab counseled and what Balaam son of Beor answered. Remember your journey from Shittim to Gilgal, so that you may acknowledge the righteousness of the LORD.’”

But David said to the Philistine, “You come against me with sword and spear and javelin, but I come against you in the name of the LORD of Hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied.

verses.text: I stretch out my hands to You; my soul thirsts for You like a parched land. Selah

xrefs.text: As for you, if you direct your heart and lift up your hands to Him,
A Psalm of David, when he was in the Wilderness of Judah. O God, You are my God. Earnestly I seek You; my soul thirsts for You. My body yearns for You in a dry and weary land without water.
My eyes grow dim with grief. I call to You daily, O LORD; I spread out my hands to You.
My soul longs, even faints, for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
For the choirmaster. A Maskil of the sons of Korah. As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul longs after You, O God.

verses.text: Answer me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide Your face from me, or I will be like those who descend to the Pit.

xrefs.text: Hide not Your face from Your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me quickly!
Of David. To You, O LORD, I call; be not deaf to me, O my Rock. For if You remain silent, I will be like those descending to the Pit.
Hide not Your face from me, nor turn away Your servant in anger. You have been my helper; do not leave me or forsake me, O God of my salvation.
Be not far from me, O God. Hurry, O my God, to help me.
I am weary from my crying; my throat is parched. My eyes fail, looking for my God.

verses.text: Let me hear Your loving devotion in the morning, for I have put my trust in You. Teach me the way I should walk, for to You I lift up my soul.

xrefs.text: Show me Your ways, O LORD; teach me Your paths.
Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding;
I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go; I will give you counsel and watch over you.
Thus says the LORD your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: “I am the LORD your God, who teaches you for your benefit, who directs you in the way you should go.
And whether you turn to the right or to the left, your ears will hear this command behind you: “This is the way. Walk in it.”

verses.text: Deliver me from my enemies, O LORD; I flee to You for refuge.

xrefs.text: The name of the LORD is a strong tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.
For You have been my refuge, a tower of strength against the enemy.

For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David, when Saul sent men to watch David’s house in order to kill him. Deliver me from my enemies, O my God; protect me from those who rise against me.
I cry to You, O LORD: “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
My soul boasts in the LORD; let the oppressed hear and rejoice.

verses.text: Teach me to do Your will, for You are my God. May Your good Spirit lead me on level ground.

xrefs.text: Show me Your ways, O LORD; teach me Your paths.
But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have told you.
equip you with every good thing to do His will. And may He accomplish in us what is pleasing in His sight through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.
He restores my soul; He guides me in the paths of righteousness for the sake of His name.
Blessed are You, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.

verses.text: For the sake of Your name, O LORD, revive me. In Your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.

xrefs.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; save me by Your righteousness.
But because of His great love for us, God, who is rich in mercy,
My soul cleaves to the dust; revive me according to Your word.
In Your justice, rescue and deliver me; incline Your ear and save me.
Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him from them all.

verses.text: And in Your loving devotion, cut off my enemies. Destroy all who afflict me, for I am Your servant.

xrefs.text: He will reward my enemies with evil. In Your faithfulness, destroy them.
Truly, O LORD, I am Your servant; I am Your servant, the son of Your maidservant; You have broken my bonds.
I am Yours; save me, for I have sought Your precepts.
But You, O God, will bring them down to the Pit of destruction; men of bloodshed and deceit will not live out half their days. But I will trust in You.
David added, “As surely as the LORD lives, the LORD Himself will strike him down; either his day will come and he will die, or he will go into battle and perish.
